fields.name: Audio
fields.description: Audio recording of the sentence pronunciation. Record directly or upload a file (max 1 MB).
fields.guidance: Record the complete sentence with natural pacing. Sentences can be slightly longer than word pronunciations, but keep them concise. Pronounce all words clearly and maintain natural sentence rhythm.

actions: Test playback to ensure the entire sentence is clear and audible
Verify the pronunciation demonstrates natural sentence flow
Add speaker and region metadata if recording different dialects or accents
